narr: A cold front slowly tracked across the region on the morning of the 11th. The slow movement of the cold front in combination with abundant moisture in place allowed for training of heavy rainfall. Over 6 inches of rain fell in a short time period which resulted in flash flooding.
ev: Several streets in Clinton were flooded and impassable due to 6.47 inches of rain.
lsr: REPORTS OF FLOODED ROADS ACROSS PORTIONS OF EAST FELICIANA PARISH. REPORT OF 6.47 INCHES OF RAIN IN CLINTON BETWEEN MIDNIGHT AND 8AM.
